ei.title: The Life and Contributions to Science Education of Mary Budd Rowe

fullPassage: Mary Budd Rowe was best known for her achievements in science education. When she was a middle school student, she met Albert Einstein and was inspired by him to study science. In 1954, she graduated from the University of California at Berkeley with a master's degree in zoology. Then she earned her doctorate degree in science education from Stanford University in 1964. Through her research, Rowe discovered that learning could be improved by increasing teachers' average "wait time" for students' responses. During her career, she directed a science education program in Harlem. She also served as President of the National Science Teachers Association. In 1990, she published her book, The Process of Knowing. Throughout her career, she practiced Einstein's advice, "Science is exploring, and exploring is fun." When she died in 1996, she was remembered as one of the leading figures in the field of science education.

questions.stem: 밑줄 없이 제시된 (A)와 (B)의 practiced의 의미로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.analysis:
✅ ② (A) 실천했다 - (B) 연습했다: (A)에서는 조언을 삶에서 '실천'한 것이고, (B)에서는 경기 준비를 위해 '연습'한 것.
❌ ① (A) 연습했다 - (B) 실천했다: (A)는 조언을 반복 연습하는 것이 아니라 삶에 적용한 것. (B)는 대회 준비를 실천한 것이 아니라 신체적 연습.
❌ ③ (A) 실천했다 - (B) 실천했다: (B)에서 농구팀이 아침마다 한 것은 '연습'이지 원칙 실천이 아님.
❌ ④ (A) 연습했다 - (B) 연습했다: (A)에서 조언을 '연습했다'는 것은 부자연스러움.
det.tip: practice: 1. 실천하다(put into practice) - 가치나 조언을 삶에 적용. 2. 연습하다(train) - 기술 향상을 위해 반복.

questions.stem:
다음 영영풀이에 해당하는 단어로 가장 적절한 것은?
"The things that someone has accomplished, especially through skill, effort, or courage."

det.analysis:
✅ ① achievements: 기술, 노력, 용기를 통해 이룬 것 = 업적.
❌ ② obstacles: '장애물'은 이룬 것이 아니라 방해하는 것.
❌ ③ failures: '실패'는 성공적으로 이룬 것의 반대.
❌ ④ tendencies: '경향'은 성취와 무관한 성향의 의미.
det.tip: achievement = 업적, 성과. accomplish(달성하다)의 명사형.

questions.passage: Through her research, Rowe discovered that learning could be improved. She made __________ (discover) that changed science education forever.
questions.stem: 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 (영어로) (   ) 쓰시오.

det.analysis: discover(동사: 발견하다) -> discoveries(명사 복수: 발견들). 'made discoveries'는 '발견을 했다'는 의미.
det.tip: discover(발견하다) -> discovery(발견, 명사 단수) -> discoveries(발견들, 명사 복수)

questions.passage: Mary Budd Rowe was best known for her achievements in science education. Her __________ (inspire) came from meeting Albert Einstein as a middle school student.
questions.stem: 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 (영어로) (   ) 쓰시오.

det.analysis: inspire(동사: 영감을 주다) -> inspiration(명사: 영감). 'Her inspiration'은 소유격 뒤에 명사가 필요.
det.tip: inspire(영감을 주다) -> inspiration(영감, 명사) -> inspirational(영감을 주는, 형용사)

questions.passage: Mary Budd Rowe was best known for her achievements in science education. When she was a middle school student, she met Albert Einstein and was inspired by him to study science. In 1954, she graduated from the University of California at Berkeley with a master's degree in zoology. Then she earned her doctorate degree in science education from Stanford University in 1964. Through her research, Rowe discovered that learning could be improved by __________. During her career, she directed a science education program in Harlem. She also served as President of the National Science Teachers Association. In 1990, she published her book, The Process of Knowing. Throughout her career, she practiced Einstein's advice, "Science is exploring, and exploring is fun." When she died in 1996, she was remembered as one of the leading figures in the field of science education.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.analysis:
✅ ② increasing teachers' average "wait time": Rowe의 핵심 연구 발견. 교사가 학생 응답을 더 오래 기다려주면 학습이 향상된다.
❌ ① reducing the number of students: 학급 규모 축소는 본문에 언급되지 않음.
❌ ③ giving students more homework: 숙제 증가는 본문의 연구 주제와 무관.
❌ ④ replacing textbooks with computers: 디지털 도구는 본문 시대(1960년대)와 내용에 맞지 않음.
det.tip: Rowe의 핵심 발견: 교사의 wait time(기다려주는 시간) 증가 -> 학생 학습 향상.

questions.passage: Mary Budd Rowe was best known for her achievements in science education. When she was a middle school student, she met Albert Einstein and was inspired by him to study science. In 1954, she graduated from the University of California at Berkeley with a master's degree in zoology. Then she earned her doctorate degree in science education from Stanford University in 1964. Through her research, Rowe discovered that learning could be improved by increasing teachers' average "wait time" for students' responses. During her career, she directed a science education program in Harlem. She also served as President of the National Science Teachers Association. In 1990, she published her book, The Process of Knowing. Throughout her career, she practiced Einstein's advice, "Science is exploring, and exploring is fun." When she died in 1996, she was remembered as __________.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 과학 교육 분야의 선도적 인물 중 한 명.
det.analysis:
✅ ④ one of the leading figures in science education: 과학 교육계의 '선도적 인물 중 한 명'으로 기억되었다는 원문.
❌ ① a controversial figure in zoology: '동물학에서의 논란이 되는 인물'은 본문과 무관.
❌ ② an ordinary teacher with no lasting impact: '지속적 영향이 없는 평범한 교사'는 업적과 모순.
❌ ③ a student who never completed her studies: '학업을 완수하지 못한 학생'은 박사 학위 취득과 모순.
det.tip: leading figure(선도적 인물) = 특정 분야를 이끌어간 주요 인물.

ch: an ordinary teacher with no lasting impact
a student who never completed her studies
one of the leading figures in science education
